notes.title: March 15, 2017 - Cutscenes Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Different language cutscenes have been found![/b][/h1]

The following languages are now available in cutscenes throughout the game:
[list]
    [*]German
    [*]Italian
    [*]Spanish
    [*]French
[/list]

Please note that although you do select a language on launch of the game, you will need to switch to the appropriate language through Steam (This is due to the original installation process the game had). Simply right-click on the game -> select properties -> select the language tab -> select an available language.

notes.title: February 8, 2017 - Hot Fix
notes.content:
[strike]Unfortunately we are missing the different language cutscenes outside of English, which mean they are being skipped. Until we are able to acquire them (No guarantee though ːsteamsadː) we had to implement this workaround.

- Missing language cutscenes will play English cutscenes instead.[/strike]

[h1][b] March 15, 2017 Update	[/b][/h1]
All cutscenes should play with their supported languages now. Please see the March 15, 2017 Update Announcement for details

tags.feature: - Missing language cutscenes will play English cutscenes instead.
